result:
**Decision: CONTINUE.** The next task is round 168, **V-3c-4b**: the Lane and Group header buttons get the same new look as last round's toolbar buttons. It is written in `current-task.md` and starts from HEAD `1fef377` with a clean tree.

**Round 167 results**
- C passed it with real browser checks at both viewports and found 0 bugs. Root published it as `1fef377` on both remotes; the gate review scored it 8/10 with nothing blocking.
- **V-3c-4a → მზადაა.** The Triplets checked-icon gap from round 166 is closed, because C saw it in the browser.
- The only blocked row is the fake-Bearer 403 check (backend unavailable in cloud).
- The previous task is copied unchanged to `tasks/round-167.md`.

**Round 168 scope.** Nothing from the V-3c-4b list was dropped; the only exclusions are non-button items.
- **Lane and Group Mute/Solo:** the outline goes and becomes a 5 % fill (8 % on hover, 12 % pressed), with 8 px corners and the same 180 ms motion as round 167.
  - When a button is on, its colour stays the same on hover and press, so it gives no hover feedback (R2).
  - The group's half-solo ("mixed") state looks exactly as it does now at rest, and gives a fill on hover (R8). This follows from how the class-merging library behaves; I checked it in node and in the browser.
- **Video import buttons:** they take the look of the transport Export button: brand border and text plus the 5 % fill, and the brand hover tint goes (R6). The backlog note had suggested only rounder corners, but Export is already approved in the spec and checked by C.
- **Buttons without an outline** (fold, track name, Pan reset, group fold and name) and the group rename field: rounder corners only (R7, R3).
- **One existing test has to change:** the theme test counts the group button's class text. A may change exactly that one string; the change is listed as G-TH in §1 and covered by mutation m203.
- **Excluded:** the drag outlines and their labels, the group overview blocks and the sliders. They are not buttons.
- **My browser trial run** (class change applied in the live page, both viewports, 5 states): no box moved (0.000 px). Text contrast stays above the 4.5:1 minimum: 5.98 on lane buttons, 5.57 on group buttons, 7.05 on the import buttons.
- **A's tests:** two new tests (LSU7, UM11) and seven mutations (m199–m205). The 12 related test files pass 249/249 today.
- **C's checks:** real audio for lane and group Mute/Solo, a real video import through the file picker, and rename followed by Undo. Rename is in the undo history, so that row can't fail because of the setup.

**For Saba (marked in `feature-status.md`, may veto):** R1/R2 on Mute/Solo, R6, R7 (the selected track name and the Pan readout get rounder ends), and R8. There is also one new question, **Q-R167-ON-HOVER**: should buttons that are on get a slightly stronger fill on hover?

**Backlog notes, not scheduled:** both round-167 reviewers propose one shared button-style constant after V-3c-4c, which I recorded as a signal. The gate reviewer's other points are also recorded as notes, not tasks:
- the button edge against its background is only about 1.12:1, which is the spec's known trade-off;
- the styling depends on the class-merging library;
- the class-name tests are fragile;
- C has not yet checked the metronome under Master Mute.

**Architecture checkpoint:** still unanswered, so this round keeps a separate copy of the classes in each component (fallback c). I repeated the request to root in `b-round-167-checkpoint-request.md`; an answer is wanted before V-3c-4c is planned, and it blocks nothing.

The advisor was available and consulted twice. Its first guess about the half-solo state was wrong, and my measurement decided R8. No application source changed. Round 169 will be the regression round if it is planned on or after 2026-10-27, otherwise V-3c-4c. `backlog.json` is now version 157.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- current-task.md
- b-round-167.md
- b-next.json
- feature-status.md
- backlog.json
- tasks/round-167.md
